starter_definition: Club-announced Week-1 starter or officially designated starter
backup_definition: 2nd string = primary backup QB2; 3rd string = QB3 practice-squad elevation
deficiency_metric: 1 − (QB1 snaps / expected QB1 snaps) per game
signal_use: Downgrade passing efficiency projection; flag N04/N10; no signal if inactive list unverified

backup_definition: 2nd string = swing tackle/guard; 3rd/4th = depth/practice squad; treat each OL slot separately
deficiency_interpretation: >0.3 = OL deficiency affecting pass pro and YPC

starter_definition: Three top depth-chart WRs by Week-1 usage
backup_definition: WR4+ are backups; injuries rotate WR3 into WR2 etc.
deficiency_metric: WR deficiency = 1 − (top-3 WR snaps / expected top-3 snaps)
deficiency_interpretation: High deficiency → target concentration vs spread target share
signal_use: Adjust WR prop opportunity; combos N07

starter_definition: RB1 Week-1 lead back; RB2 primary backup
deficiency_metric: RB workload deficiency = 1 − (RB1 carries+targets share vs expected)
deficiency_interpretation: Backup share >0.6 signals workload flip to RB2
signal_use: Rushing prop N05; negatively correlates with RB1/RB2 pair C05

deficiency_interpretation: Affects pass targets and blocking grades

starter_definition: Starting 3–4 or 4–3 front (3 or 4 DL starters)
backup_definition: Rotational DE/DT backups; 2nd/3rd string per film depth chart
deficiency_metric: DL pressure deficiency = 1 − (starter DL snaps / expected; sack expectation falls)
deficiency_interpretation: High DL deficiency → higher opponent QB YPA

deficiency_metric: Secondary deficiency = average across starting DB slots
deficiency_interpretation: Very high sensitivity: 3rd-string CB covering WR1 is acute deficiency
signal_use: WR yardage props vs secondary C07

deficiency_metric: K deficiency = 1 if backup K active else 0
deficiency_interpretation: Backup K impacts long-FG expectation and total projections
